verses.text: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
lines: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good,
for his loving kindness endures forever.

verses.text: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
lines: Let Israel now say
that his loving kindness endures forever.

verses.text: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
lines: Let the house of Aaron now say
that his loving kindness endures forever.

verses.text: Now let those who fear Yahweh say that his loving kindness endures forever.
lines: Now let those who fear Yahweh say
that his loving kindness endures forever.

verses.text: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
lines: Out of my distress, I called on Yah.
Yah answered me with freedom.

verses.text: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
lines: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid.
What can man do to me?

verses.text: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
lines: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me.
Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

verses.text: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.
lines: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh,
than to put confidence in man.

verses.text: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.
lines: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh,
than to put confidence in princes.

verses.text: All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.
lines: All the nations surrounded me,
but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.

verses.text: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In Yahweh’s name I indeed cut them off.
lines: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me.
In Yahweh’s name I indeed cut them off.

verses.text: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In Yahweh’s name I cut them off.
lines: They surrounded me like bees.
They are quenched like the burning thorns.
In Yahweh’s name I cut them off.

verses.text: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.
lines: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall,
but Yahweh helped me.

verses.text: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
lines: Yah is my strength and song.
He has become my salvation.

verses.text: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.
lines: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous.
“The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.

verses.text: The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”
lines: The right hand of Yahweh is exalted!
The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”

verses.text: I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works.
lines: I will not die, but live,
and declare Yah’s works.

verses.text: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
lines: Yah has punished me severely,
but he has not given me over to death.

verses.text: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.
lines: Open to me the gates of righteousness.
I will enter into them.
I will give thanks to Yah.

verses.text: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.
lines: This is the gate of Yahweh;
the righteous will enter into it.

verses.text: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
lines: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me,
and have become my salvation.

verses.text: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
lines: The stone which the builders rejected
has become the cornerstone.

verses.text: This is Yahweh’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
lines: This is Yahweh’s doing.
It is marvelous in our eyes.

verses.text: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
lines: This is the day that Yahweh has made.
We will rejoice and be glad in it!

verses.text: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.
lines: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh!
Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.

verses.text: Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name! We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.
lines: Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name!
We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.

verses.text: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
lines: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light.
Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

verses.text: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
lines: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you.
You are my God, I will exalt you.

verses.text: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
lines: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good,
for his loving kindness endures forever.
